caption: The drawing depicts three human figures in an outdoor setting with lush vegetation and rocky terrain. The figure on the left is kneeling on the ground, dressed in a light green shirt and dark green pants, with brown hair, reaching out toward the two other figures. The middle figure is seated on a rock, wearing a dark green coat, matching pants, and a dark wide-brimmed hat, with light-colored shoes. The rightmost figure, standing partly bent over, wears a long, flowing pink dress with darker pink accents, a black cape or shawl, a red hat, and holds a light-colored hat in her left hand. The scene is framed by large green plants, pink flowers, and beige rocks. The predominant colors used are green, pink, beige, brown, and red. The composition places the figures in the foreground with the plants and rocks providing a natural background. The artist's signature, "Paul Gihbo," appears in the bottom left corner of the drawing.
title: Tapestry
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
